info.title: yamca
info.description: Yamca — a local-first Blazor agent / chat UI that runs as a .NET global tool. Launch with `yamca` from any directory to chat against a workspace.

commands.name: reinit
commands.description:
Restore the default column structure of the dev board.
Cards in non-default columns are moved to idea.
Pass --wipe to delete all cards instead.

options.name: --port
options.description:
Listen on a specific port (default: 9001, or an
OS-assigned port when 9001 is already in use).

options.name: --no-browser
options.description: Do not open the default browser on startup.

options.name: --wipe
options.description: (board reinit) Delete all cards instead of moving to idea.

options.name: --version
options.description: Print the tool version and exit.

arguments.name: WORKSPACE_PATH
arguments.description: Directory to sandbox the agent to (default: current directory).
